statement:
∀ (s C : ℝ) (A : KdVPlan.Coeff → KdVPlan.Coeff → KdVPlan.Coeff → KdVPlan.Coeff), (∀ f f' g g' h h' : KdVPlan.Coeff,
 KdVPlan.MemH s f → KdVPlan.MemH s f' → KdVPlan.MemH s g → KdVPlan.MemH s g' → KdVPlan.MemH s h → KdVPlan.MemH s h' →
 A (f-f') g h = A f g h-A f' g h ∧ A f (g-g') h = A f g h-A f g' h ∧ A f g (h-h') = A f g h-A f g h') → (∀ f g h : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH s f → KdVPlan.MemH s g → KdVPlan.MemH s h → KdVPlan.HB 0 (A f g h) (C*KdVPlan.hn s f*KdVPlan.hn s g*KdVPlan.hn s h)) →
 ∀ (fn gn hn : ℕ → KdVPlan.Coeff) (f g h : KdVPlan.Coeff),
 (∀ n, KdVPlan.MemH s (fn n)) → (∀ n, KdVPlan.MemH s (gn n)) → (∀ n, KdVPlan.MemH s (hn n)) →
 KdVPlan.SeqConv s fn f → KdVPlan.SeqConv s gn g → KdVPlan.SeqConv s hn h →
 KdVPlan.SeqConv 0 (fun n => A (fn n) (gn n) (hn n)) (A f g h)
proof:
intro s C A hs hb fn gn hn f g h hfm hgm hhm hf hg hh
have hdf := @yui_aux_0047 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s fn f hf
have hdg := @yui_aux_0047 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s gn g hg
have hdh := @yui_aux_0047 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s hn h hh
have hgn := @yui_aux_0048 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s gn g hgm hg
have hhn := @yui_aux_0048 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s hn h hhm hh
have hbound := fun n => @yui_aux_0049 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s C A hs hb f (fn n) g (gn n) h (hn n) hf.1 (hfm n) hg.1 (hgm n) hh.1 (hhm n)
have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => KdVPlan.hn 0 (A (fn n) (gn n) (hn n)-A f g h)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
 apply squeeze_zero (fun n => Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (fun n => (hbound n).2)
 have h₁ := ((hdf.const_mul C).mul hgn).mul hhn
 have h₂ := ((hdg.const_mul (C*KdVPlan.hn s f)).mul hhn)
 have h₃ := hdh.const_mul (C*KdVPlan.hn s f*KdVPlan.hn s g)
 simpa only [mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] using (h₁.add h₂).add h₃
refine ⟨(hb f g h hf.1 hg.1 hh.1).1, ?_⟩
intro ε hε
obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hlim ε hε
refine ⟨m, fun n hnm => ⟨(hbound n).1, ?_⟩⟩
have hp : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.hn 0 (A (fn n) (gn n) (hn n)-A f g h) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
exact le_of_lt (by simpa only [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hp] using hm n hnm)
